question:
Select the option that is related to the figure (C) in the same way as figure (B) is related to figure (A).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28eba5f999b2ae68b40feb54ae62eb9e2e5c365df41f1596e30b354a09cc2237.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• The figure is** inverted vertically** in its position.
 
• All the **surrounding symbols** are also** inverted vertically** in their** respective places.**
 
• The **symbol** in the **middle** is moved to the **top right corner **of the box.

Therefore in the **second case:**

 
• The **triangle** will be** inverted vertically**.
 
• The** surrounding symbols** will also be **inverted vertically.**
 
• the **middle symbol **will be is moved to the top right corner of the box.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32b8cf9f3880e9ac72b7e4171147e2cf5967024005b115182d7f014e1c3753dc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "*option 1*".
